ocr.notes: One line near the end is garbled in the transcript ('Allen was at his saloon last evening, and is looking well'), but it is clear in the image.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that the last deposit for the Allen and Gallagher fight was made at Tom Allen's saloon, with the fight set for November 1, probably near the site of the last mill.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, October 25, 1870'.

facts.fact: The last preliminary deposit for the Allen and Gallagher fight ($200 for Allen, $100 for Gallagher) was made at Allen's saloon. The fight was set for November 1, probably near the site of the last mill, with a boat to be chartered
Allen eased his training for several days after a report that Gallagher was sick
